newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares nudge ahead, seen treading water.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares nudge ahead, seen treading water.

text.p: Slovenian shares were moderately higher on Friday, recovering their poise after recent falls, and traders forecast the market would remain steady short term.
The 10-share SBI index rose 2.27 points to 1,152.2. Overall five shares rose, 10 fell and 10 were untraded.
Turnover rose to 186.1 million tolars from 166.7 million.
Drug producer Lek's "A" issue was the most active share, falling 0.16 percent to 18,840 tolars on volume of 5,999 shares for total turnover of 113.0 million tolars.
Financial consultancy Finmedia was the biggest gainer, jumping 9.41 percent to 16,400 tolars on volume of 485 shares for total turnover of 7.5 million tolars.
Ordinary shares of Hipotekarna bank Brezice were the leading decliner, falling 10 percent to 3,330 tolars on volume of 20 shares.
